description: This file implements asynchronous helper functions for UI thread execution, delays, and sleep functionality within a Windows application, specifically for the Calculator app. It defines methods for running actions on the UI thread, delaying execution, and sleeping the thread.

classes.name: AsyncHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing asynchronous execution and delay functions for UI thread operations in a Windows application.

methods.name: RunOnUIThreadAsync
methods.description: Executes a given action asynchronously on the UI thread and returns a task representing the operation.

methods.name: RunOnUIThread
methods.description: Runs a given action on the UI thread with a specified timeout, waiting for completion.

methods.name: Delay
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of milliseconds using a separate thread.

methods.name: Sleep
methods.description: Pauses the current thread for a specified number of milliseconds.
